acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce on the corpus-gh-1022w lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1559, head 7c1a864ac, BASE 503d4ea3a) or an equivalent: rebind after merging origin/main, then dogfood-change from a plain clone.
Either dogfood-change succeeds, or the refusal names the missing object id and the remedy (for example a fetch of the base), with a regression test.
body: Suspected defect. In lane corpus-gh-1022w, after review fixes and a merge of origin/main (BASE 503d4ea3aa2520a9c26dc4d37e2da62401387696, head 7c1a864ac), make dogfood-change in a plain clean clone refused twice with ocm-prepare-001 repository-object-unavailable, so dogfood-check and the seal were NOT_PRODUCED. Running the same OCM prepare step on its own succeeded. The refusal does not say which object is missing. Corvint build 713.
title: dogfood-change refuses with ocm-prepare-001 repository-object-unavailable in a plain clone after a lane merges origin/main, while standalone prepare succeeds
